title: Once the popup has focus, can't transfer it to the tray icons that are  on the panel
line: Pressing Down past the last row of the System Tray popup now moves keyboard focus to the tray icons in the panel.
explanation: The tray's hidden-items popup is a separate window from the panel, and its grid simply stopped at its last row, so keyboard focus could never leave the popup for the icons shown in the panel. The panel only accepts keyboard focus when its containment is in AcceptingInputStatus (what Meta+Alt+P uses). Now pressing the arrow key towards the panel past the grid's edge (Down for bottom panels, Left/Right for side panels) closes the popup, puts the panel into that input mode and focuses the first tray icon, from where the panel's usual arrow-key navigation continues.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: let keyboard focus move from popup to panel icons

After opening the System Tray with its shortcut, the arrow keys only
moved around the popup, so the icons shown in the panel could not be
reached. Moving past the popup's edge by the panel now focuses them.

BUG: 520583

media.caption: Master: tray shortcut, Down x3, Return: focus stays in the popup and Return opens Display Configuration
Fixed: the third Down leaves the popup for the first panel icon and Return opens Audio Volume
Master: after the same keys, Display Configuration (last popup item) opened
Fixed: after the same keys, Audio Volume (first panel tray icon) opened

review.text: Good direction for transferring keyboard focus from the System Tray popup to the visible tray icons in the panel, and the bottom-panel demo works as shown. However, three issues need fixing before merge: top panels (TopEdge) are completely unhandled so top-panel users still cannot reach panel tray icons; focusVisibleItems() sets Plasmoid.containment.status = PlasmaCore.Types.AcceptingInputStatus on the inner System Tray containment without ever resetting it on focus loss (which can keep auto-hide panels permanently stuck open); and the RTL edge check for LeftEdge panels misses currentIndex === count - 1 on incomplete rows.
changes: Support top panels (PlasmaCore.Types.TopEdge), e.g. by letting Up past the popup header buttons in ExpandedRepresentation.qml call root.focusVisibleItems() so top-panel users can also move focus to tray icons.

Reset Plasmoid.containment.status from AcceptingInputStatus when focus leaves the panel/tray (or request panel focus through a mechanism that clears the status on focus loss) so auto-hide panels do not stay stuck open, and verify with an auto-hide panel.
Fix the RTL edge condition in HiddenItemsView.qml so currentIndex === count - 1 is checked on the visual trailing edge (RightEdge in LTR, LeftEdge in RTL) rather than unconditionally on RightEdge.

reviews.text: Good direction and the right place (systemtray applet): Down past the popup grid's last row closes the popup, puts the containment in AcceptingInputStatus as Meta+Alt+P does, and focuses the first visible tray item, which is the reporter's suggested interaction, and the bottom-panel video shows it working. But the bug is 'can't move focus from the popup to the panel icons' in general, and the patch leaves top panels unhandled (the notes say so), which is a common layout, while the Left/Right paths for side panels were never run. As submitted it closes the bug only for bottom panels.
changes: Handle top panels too, e.g. Up from the popup's header row (or from the first grid row when it is the topmost focusable row) moves focus to the panel icons, so every panel edge has a path to them.

Test and show the Left/Right side-panel paths (including RTL) and the top-panel path on the rig, and note the behavior when the tray has no visible panel items (nextItemInFocusChain then lands on the expander arrow).
